articles.title_en: Labor Supply and Entertainment Innovations: Evidence from the US TV Rollout
articles.title_cn: 劳动力供给与娱乐创新：来自美国电视推广的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of entertainment technology on labor supply. Using Social Security work histories and a natural experiment arising from the regulated US rollout of television, we estimate that a station launch reduced the probability of working by around 0.3 percentage points, driven mainly by an increase in older-age-group retirement rates. The results support the hypothesis that television's rise contributed to the midcentury transition of retirement from a necessity to “golden years” of enjoyment. Our findings indicate that entertainment innovations have a less pronounced effect on overall labor supply trends than model calibrations in the previous literature suggest. (JEL D91, J22, J26, L82, N32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了娱乐技术对劳动力供给的影响。利用社会保障工作历史记录以及美国电视受监管推广所产生的自然实验，我们估计，一个电视台的开播使工作概率降低了约0.3个百分点，这主要由老年群体退休率的上升所驱动。结果支持了电视的兴起促成了退休从必需品向“黄金岁月”享受转变的世纪中叶转型这一假设。我们的发现表明，娱乐创新对整体劳动力供给趋势的影响比先前文献中的模型校准所暗示的要小。(JEL D91, J22, J26, L82, N32)

articles.title_en: Home Sweet Home: Returns to Returning in the Age of Mass Migration
articles.title_cn: 甜蜜的家：大规模移民时代返乡的回报
articles.abstract_en: Despite significant circular migration flows historically and today, their economic impacts remain understudied. Using data on predominantly rural Swedish migrants who returned from the United States during the Age of Mass Migration, we estimate returns to temporary migration in terms of wealth, income, demographic, and social outcomes. We find substantial wealth effects but limited evidence of increased labor income or occupational upgrading. Male returnees held nearly double the wealth of stayers, likely due to overseas savings, while female returnees gained wealth mainly through marriage. These findings highlight the need to consider wealth when evaluating the economic returns of temporary migration. (JEL F22, G51, J15, J16, N31, N33)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管历史上和当今都存在显著的循环移民流动，但其经济影响仍未得到充分研究。利用大规模移民时代从美国返回的以农村为主的瑞典移民数据，我们估计了临时移民在财富、收入、人口统计和社会结果方面的回报。我们发现显著的财富效应，但关于劳动收入增加或职业提升的证据有限。男性返乡者的财富几乎是未迁移者的两倍，这很可能归因于海外储蓄，而女性返乡者主要通过婚姻获得财富。这些发现强调在评估临时移民的经济回报时需要考虑财富因素。（JEL F22, G51, J15, J16, N31, N33）

articles.title_en: Down to the Wire: Leveraging Technology to Improve Electric Utility Cost Recovery
articles.title_cn: 直击要害：利用技术提升电力公用事业成本回收
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of a technical intervention in Karachi, Pakistan—converting bare distribution wires to aerial bundled cables (ABCs)—that was intended to prevent illegal grid connections and improve utility cost recovery. Theft-resistant cables reduced losses. This occurred primarily through decreases in unbilled consumption, with the number of formal utility customers and their billed consumption both increasing. Load-shedding outages decreased. In areas with these cables installed, consumers have more appliances and higher electricity-related expenditures. Revenue recovery rose, but consumers' billing-related complaints also increased. (JEL D24, L94, O13, Q41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了巴基斯坦卡拉奇的一项技术干预措施的效果——将裸露配电线路转换为架空绝缘电缆（ABCs）——该措施旨在防止非法电网连接并改善公用事业成本回收。防窃电缆减少了损耗。这主要通过未计费消费的减少实现，正式公用事业客户数量及其计费消费均有所增加。限电停电次数减少。在安装这些电缆的区域，消费者拥有更多电器和更高的电力相关支出。收入回收增加，但消费者关于计费的投诉也增加了。（JEL D24, L94, O13, Q41）

articles.title_en: Labor Market Inequality and the Changing Life Cycle Profile of Male and Female Wages
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场不平等与男女工资生命周期曲线的变化
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the full distribution of life cycle wages for cohorts of men and women in the United States using a quantile selection model to account for systematic differences in employment by gender and education group. Although common within-group time effects are shown to be a key driver of labor market inequalities across gender, important additional differences by birth cohort emerge with more recent cohorts of women delaying child rearing and, by implication, the onset of child penalties in wages. These cross-cohort differences help account for the stalling of progress in gender wage gaps over the past quarter century. (JEL D15, J13, J16, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用分位数选择模型，估计了美国不同出生队列男性和女性整个生命周期的工资分布，以考虑按性别和教育群体划分的就业系统性差异。尽管组内共同时间效应被证明是跨性别劳动力市场不平等的主要驱动因素，但更近期的出生队列中，女性推迟生育，从而推迟了工资中子女惩罚的开始时间，这导致了重要的额外差异。这些跨队列差异有助于解释过去四分之一世纪中性别工资差距进展停滞的现象。(JEL D15, J13, J16, J24, J31)

articles.title_en: The Franchise, Policing, and Race: Evidence from Arrests Data and the Voting Rights Act
articles.title_cn: 选举权、警务与种族：来自逮捕数据与《投票权利法》的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between the franchise and policing. We find that, following the Voting Rights Act of 1965, Black arrest rates in counties that both had more newly enfranchised Blacks and were covered by the legislation fell, compared to similar Southern counties that were not covered. We document no corresponding patterns for White arrests. Our results are driven by arrests by sheriffs, who are always elected, and by less serious offenses. These results indicate that voting rights, when combined with electoral accountability, lead to improved treatment of minority groups by police. (JEL D72, J15, K16, K42, N32, N42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了选举权与警务之间的关系。我们发现，在1965年《投票权利法》通过后，与未被该法案覆盖的类似南方县相比，那些既有更多新获得选举权的黑人又受该法案覆盖的县，其黑人逮捕率有所下降。我们没有发现白人逮捕率有相应的变化模式。我们的结果主要由治安官（他们总是经选举产生）执行的逮捕以及较轻的罪行所驱动。这些结果表明，选举权与选举问责制相结合时，会导致警察对少数群体待遇的改善。（JEL D72, J15, K16, K42, N32, N42）

articles.abstract_en: This paper tests whether partially unemployed workers value future preserved benefits when they bunch at the kink of the unemployment insurance benefit-withdrawal schedule. I extend the bunching formula of Saez (2010) to a dynamic setting that accounts for the value of future benefits tied to taxation. This yields new tests of tax-benefit linkage based on bunching heterogeneity. I verify in quasi-experiments that UI extension programs that decrease the value of future preserved benefits lead to more bunching and to lower labor supply. Last, a quantification exercise of the dynamic bunching formula provides extra support for a strong tax-benefit linkage. (JEL H24, H31, H71, J22, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文检验了部分失业工人在失业保险金递减计划的拐点处聚集时，是否重视未来保留的福利。我将Saez（2010）的聚集公式扩展到动态设定，该设定考虑了与税收挂钩的未来福利价值。这产生了基于聚集异质性的税收-福利关联的新检验。我在准实验中验证，降低未来保留福利价值的失业保险扩展计划会导致更多的聚集和更低的劳动供给。最后，动态聚集公式的量化练习为强烈的税收-福利关联提供了额外支持。（JEL H24, H31, H71, J22, J65）

articles.title_en: Pulled In and Crowded Out: Heterogeneous Outcomes of Merit-Based School Choice
articles.title_cn: 被拉入与挤出：基于成绩的学校选择中的异质性结果
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of reforming the high school admission system from a residence based allocation to a merit-based allocation. The merit-based system generates oversubscribed schools, which favor high-GPA students at the expense of displacing low-GPA ones. We use the potential outcomes framework to analyze the effects of the reform, separating the effects for those gaining access to competitive schools from those losing access and identifying these parameters by using the reform as an instrument within subpopulations defined by admission cutoffs and GPA. The small and negative overall effect of the reform hides large negative effects for the crowded-out students. (JEL H51, I21, I28)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了将高中入学制度从基于居住地的分配改革为基于成绩的分配所产生的影响。基于成绩的制度产生了超额申请的学校，这些学校偏向高GPA学生，以牺牲低GPA学生为代价。我们使用潜在结果框架来分析改革的影响，将获得竞争性学校入学机会的学生与失去机会的学生的影响分开，并通过在由录取分数线和GPA定义的子群体中使用改革作为工具变量来识别这些参数。改革的总体效应小而负面，但掩盖了被挤出学生的巨大负面效应。(JEL H51, I21, I28)

articles.title_en: Where Do My Tax Dollars Go? Tax Morale Effects of Perceived Government Spending
articles.title_cn: 我的税款去向何处？感知政府支出对纳税道德的影响
articles.abstract_en: Do perceptions about government spending affect willingness to pay taxes? We test this hypothesis with a natural field experiment that focuses on the allocation of property taxes to public schools. Our results show that taxpayers often misperceive the destination of their tax dollars. By introducing shocks to households' perceptions via an information-provision experiment, we find that perceptions of how tax dollars are used significantly affect the probability of filing a tax appeal. Moreover, the effects are consistent with reciprocal motivations: individuals are more willing to pay taxes if they believe that the government services funded by those taxes will provide greater personal benefit. (JEL C93, D12, H26, H71, H72, H75)
articles.abstract_cn: 关于政府支出的感知是否会影响纳税意愿？我们通过一项自然实地实验来检验这一假设，该实验聚焦于财产税对公立学校的分配。我们的结果表明，纳税人常常误解其税款的去向。通过信息提供实验引入对家庭感知的冲击，我们发现对税款使用方式的感知显著影响提交纳税申诉的概率。此外，这些效应与互惠动机一致：如果个人相信由这些税款资助的政府服务将带来更大的个人利益，他们更愿意纳税。(JEL C93, D12, H26, H71, H72, H75)
